quotes.name: Duskrider Falcon
quotes.flavor:
"Seaborne ships have their dolphins to dance in their wakes; I have my duskriders."
—Sisay, journal

quotes.name: Neutralize
quotes.flavor: On Ikoria, reactive magic can make the difference between barely grazed and really dead.

quotes.name: Alabaster Mage
quotes.flavor:
"We hold sacred the powers of light and life. Truth and honor are our greatest weapons."
—Alabaster creed

quotes.name: Orochi Merge-Keeper
quotes.flavor: One day the spirit and mortal realms will be one. Until then, she faithfully guards the sites where they merge.

quotes.name: Onulet
quotes.flavor: An early inspiration for Urza, Tocasia's onulets contained magical essences that could be cannibalized after they stopped functioning.

quotes.name: Chapel Geist
quotes.flavor: Death has bound it with chains of past regrets. Forever it searches for atonement, each kindness removing a single link.

quotes.name: Giver of Runes
quotes.flavor: She provides marks of protection to those she chooses as family.

quotes.name: Silverflame Squire // On Alert
quotes.flavor: Beacons along the borderlands are lit at any incursion from the wilds.

quotes.name: Scatter the Seeds
quotes.flavor: From the seeds of faith, great forests grow.

quotes.name: White Orchid Phantom
quotes.flavor: His oath required no service beyond death, but his honor demanded it.

quotes.name: Army of the Damned
quotes.flavor: Sometimes death comes knocking. Sometimes it tears down the walls.

quotes.name: Anticipate
quotes.flavor: "You thought I wouldn't see that coming?"

quotes.name: Parallel Lives
quotes.flavor:
"Brave Syr Armont mused: Was the elves' true nature that of day's civility or night's savagery? Could such bestial rage be bestowed by curse alone?"
—*Curse of the Werefox*

quotes.name: Reanimate
quotes.flavor:
"You'd better be worth it."
—Liliana Vess

quotes.name: Shielded Passage
quotes.flavor: Izzet delved into the depths of Ravnica's past, and Selesnya followed without fear.

quotes.name: Hedron Archive
quotes.flavor: The vaults of the Necron Dynasties contain all manner of esoteric artifacts, most forged long before many of the younger races even existed.

quotes.name: Breath of Dreams
quotes.flavor:
"Get up, blast you! They're attacking! Why are you all so slow?"
—General Jarkeld, the Arctic Fox

quotes.name: Sparktongue Dragon
quotes.flavor: Fools believe that Kolaghan's brood follows lightning storms. The wise know that it is the other way around.

quotes.name: Brass's Bounty
quotes.flavor:
"Why squabble for trinkets when we could be living large off all this gold?"
—Admiral Beckett Brass

quotes.name: Crystal Barricade
quotes.flavor:
"Good as new!"
—Krek, daysquad captain

quotes.name: Baral, Chief of Compliance
quotes.flavor: In light of his zealous defense of Kaladesh, the Consulate was willing to overlook any previous transgressions.

quotes.name: Savai Thundermane
quotes.flavor: A crackling roar is the last sound many hunters hear.

quotes.name: Etherium Sculptor
quotes.flavor: The greatest masters of the craft abandon tools altogether, shaping metal with hand and mind alone.

quotes.name: Empty the Warrens
quotes.flavor:
Kicking the warren
—Argivian expression meaning "causing trouble"

quotes.name: Grand Abolisher
quotes.flavor: "Your superstitions and mumblings are useless chaff before my righteousness."

quotes.name: Sephiroth, Planet's Heir
quotes.flavor: "This is the end... for all of you."

quotes.name: Assembly-Worker
quotes.flavor: With their factories long destroyed, some of Mishra's creations still toil in remote areas, endlessly performing and reperforming their last orders.

quotes.name: Sai of the Shinobi
quotes.flavor: The passing of the sai presages the end of the old clan and the ascent of the new.

quotes.name: Martyr of Spores
quotes.flavor: "Weep not for me. I will rise with the spring's new growth."

quotes.name: Robe of Mirrors
quotes.flavor: "Does this make me look fat?"

quotes.name: Gang Up
quotes.flavor:
"Well, who do we have here, Gorm?"
"No one, Virtus. No one at all."

quotes.name: Hellish Rebuke
quotes.flavor: Redecorating is a passion. Revenge is just fun.

quotes.name: Thermo-Alchemist
quotes.flavor: "Madness can't touch a mind ignited by genius."

quotes.name: Tragic Slip
quotes.flavor: Linger on death's door and risk being invited in.

quotes.name: Rancid Rats
quotes.flavor: "They're in the walls! Can't you hear them?"

quotes.name: Tainted Strike
quotes.flavor:
"Welcome to perfection."
—Sheoldred, Whispering One

quotes.name: Admiral Beckett Brass
quotes.set_name: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Commander
quotes.flavor: "You and your ship will make a fine addition to my fleet."

quotes.name: Keys to the House
quotes.flavor: If you find them, they wanted to be found.

quotes.name: Grixis Panorama
quotes.flavor: There is no height above Grixis that is free from the stench of death.

quotes.name: Social Snub
quotes.flavor: "Sorry. This seat's taken."

quotes.name: Needle Storm
quotes.flavor: The rain is driven like nails.

quotes.name: Raiders' Wake
quotes.flavor: One was spared to tell the gruesome tale.

quotes.name: Terminate
quotes.flavor:
"I've seen death before. My mother succumbing to illness, my comrades bleeding on the battlefield . . . But I'd never seen anything as dreadful as that."
—Taani, berserker of Etlan

quotes.name: Rapid Hybridization
quotes.flavor:
"We've merged your life essence with that of several creatures at once. You're welcome."
—Speaker Trifon

quotes.name: Angelic Protector
quotes.flavor:
"My family sheltered in her light, the dark was content to wait."
—Crovax

quotes.name: Winter Orb
quotes.flavor:
"When once winter has ahold,
Not willingly does she withdraw
Her icy touch, wistfully caressing—
The deepened air sleeps its cold."
—Aline Corralurn, "Late Thaw"

quotes.name: Dark Ritual
quotes.flavor:
"Leshrac, my liege, grant me the power I am due."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

quotes.name: Hive Mind Coprocessor
quotes.flavor: "Consensus achieved. Disseminating."

quotes.name: Squandered Resources
quotes.flavor:
"He traded sand for skins, skins for gold, gold for life. In the end, he traded life for sand."
—Afari, *Tales*

quotes.name: Field of Ruin
quotes.flavor:
"There's some devilry at work in the Shire."
—Sam

quotes.name: Redwood Treefolk
quotes.flavor: The soldiers chopped and chopped, and still the great tree stood, frowning down at them.

quotes.name: Jasmine Boreal of the Seven
quotes.flavor: "I've had my adventures. All I wish now is to sit in peace and speak with the pines."

quotes.name: Pressure Point
quotes.flavor: Everything has an off switch.

quotes.name: Furnace of Rath
quotes.flavor: The furnace awaits the next master who would stoke the fires of apocalypse.

quotes.name: Giada, Font of Hope
quotes.flavor: The source of the Cabaretti's Halo turned out to be a single teenage girl.

quotes.name: Nullmage Shepherd
quotes.flavor: The Skelle spent days carving runes and erecting their scorn poles. The herd crushed them to splinters in seconds.

quotes.name: Quiet Speculation
quotes.flavor:
"The best foresight is hindsight."
—Empress Llawan

quotes.name: Ancestral Recall
quotes.flavor: 2022 Europe Vintage Championship

quotes.name: Darkwater Catacombs
quotes.flavor: The mirelurks seem significantly happier here than the commuters were.

quotes.name: Supplant Form
quotes.flavor:
"Ice can be shaped to any form, even the whisper of a memory."
—Mytha, Temur shaman

quotes.name: Fumigate
quotes.flavor:
"Ghirapur's gremlin population poses a threat to the infrastructure of the fairgrounds. Threats must be eliminated."
—Sram, senior edificer

quotes.name: Farseek
quotes.flavor: "How truly vast this city must be, that I have traveled so far and seen so much, yet never once found the place where the buildings fail."

quotes.name: Lavalanche
quotes.flavor: Alara's burning blood cannot be contained by mere earth and stone.

quotes.name: Andradite Leech
quotes.flavor:
"Older specimens are completely encrusted with gems, which serve as both armor and weapons."
—Tolarian research notes

quotes.name: Sunhome Enforcer
quotes.flavor:
"Law soothed his savage heart. Where fury once burned, the enduring flame of order now shines."
—Razia

quotes.name: Flare
quotes.flavor:
"In the forest, fires light the sky as black clouds unfold their weight."
—"Love Song of Night and Day"

quotes.name: Danitha, New Benalia's Light
quotes.set_name: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
quotes.flavor: Danitha had spent her whole life preparing to lead House Capashen, but she mourned that the opportunity had come so soon.

quotes.name: Finale of Devastation
quotes.flavor: Some spells sing a quiet tune. Others roar.

quotes.name: Urgent Necropsy
quotes.flavor:
"The Golgari can read the dead like a newspaper."
—Taboro of the Foundway Associates

quotes.name: Aspect of Gorgon
quotes.flavor:
"My adopted children are loved no less."
—Pharika, god of affliction

quotes.name: Vendetta
quotes.flavor: Starke knew the voice was Takara's, but the venom was Volrath's.

quotes.name: Tam, Mindful First-Year
quotes.flavor: "What are the odds? And what would you like them to be?"

quotes.name: Sepulcher Ghoul
quotes.flavor: Ghouls devour the dead and any living creatures unwary enough to fall into their grasp.

quotes.name: Ornithopter
quotes.flavor: Regardless of the century, plane, or species, developing artificers never fail to invent the ornithopter.

quotes.name: Kindlespark Duo
quotes.flavor: "We burn like fire!" cackled the lizard. "And strike like lightning!" the otter thundered.

quotes.name: Royal Assassin
quotes.flavor: Trained in the arts of stealth, royal assassins choose their victims carefully, relying on timing and precision rather than brute force.

quotes.name: Circle of Dreams Druid
quotes.set_name: Adventures in the Forgotten Realms Promos
quotes.flavor: The realms protected by druids of the Circle of Dreams are gleaming, fruitful places, where dream and reality blur together and the weary can find rest.

quotes.name: Enduring Sliver
quotes.flavor: Time has ground mountains to sand, but the slivers ever remain.

quotes.name: Twinning Glass
quotes.flavor: It takes two to craft a mirror: a practiced metalsmith to silver one side and her own hazy reflection to polish the other.

quotes.name: Aurelia, the Warleader
quotes.flavor: Where Razia was aloof and untouchable, Aurelia is on the frontlines, calling for war.

quotes.name: Spiderwig Boggart
quotes.flavor: Auntie Flint was the first to pioneer the spiderwig, a mass of arachnids intended to be worn rather than eaten.

quotes.name: Nomad Mythmaker
quotes.flavor: Nomads weave tales thicker than tapestries.

quotes.name: Haazda Exonerator
quotes.flavor: "This aura threatens the sanctity of your soul. Wrenching it free won't be easy on either of us. If you're ready, we'll begin."

quotes.name: Ixalan's Binding
quotes.flavor: Jace awoke to the certainty that he was lost.

quotes.name: Shyft
quotes.flavor:
"Capturing this specimen was not easy. Study it well, that you someday might be as versatile."
—Gerda Äagesdotter, Archmage of the Unseen

quotes.name: HYDRA Troopers
quotes.flavor: Evil never lacks foot soldiers to do its will.

quotes.name: Etali, Primal Storm
quotes.set_name: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Commander
quotes.flavor: The storm rages and the earth breaks.

quotes.name: Stonybrook Banneret
quotes.flavor: Made from trout scales and crawfish whiskers, merrows' shimmering banners flash in the water like lightning.

quotes.name: Tormented Soul
quotes.flavor: Those who raged most bitterly at the world in life are cursed to roam the nether realms in death.

quotes.name: Meeting of the Five
quotes.flavor: For years, the five families ruled New Capenna in uneasy peace, and the city prospered.

quotes.name: Troll Negotiations
quotes.flavor: Suddenly they were fighting like dogs, and calling one another all sorts of perfectly true and applicable names in very loud voices.

quotes.name: Assemble the Players
quotes.flavor:
"All will soon be made clear, but I can give you this: our killer is here with us, in this very room."
—Alquist Proft

quotes.name: Sunken Hollow
quotes.flavor: On the continent of Tazeem, rushing waters plunge through narrow canyons into mist-cloaked lakes.

quotes.name: Hanweir Watchkeep // Bane of Hanweir
quotes.flavor: Technically he never left his post. He looks after the wolf wherever it goes.

quotes.name: Behold the Power of Destruction
quotes.flavor: "I must break the world before I can remake it in my image."

quotes.name: Battle Hymn
quotes.flavor:
"In peace I chanted peace, but now the drum of war is mine, / War, red war is my song through your streets..."
—Walt Whitman, "City of Ships"

quotes.name: Hinterland Harbor
quotes.flavor:
"Our ancestors brought down a Phyrexian portal ship, then built our town on its hull. We're pretty proud of that."
—Alene of Riverspan

quotes.name: Botanical Sanctum
quotes.flavor: "Exterminate all life forms below. Exterminate!"

quotes.name: Sunken Hollow
quotes.flavor:
"So, we are fighting an unknown homicidal force that has taken the form of your commanding officer and a cowardly alien, underwater, in a nuclear reactor. Anything else I should know?"
—The Twelfth Doctor

quotes.name: Isolated Chapel
quotes.flavor: Serra's blessing lies strongest upon Sursi, where her holy chapels are untouched even as evil encroaches.

quotes.name: Easy Prey
quotes.flavor: The definition of "bite-sized treat" depends on who you ask.

quotes.name: Hidden Herbalists
quotes.flavor: In the cellars beneath Narnam House, a strange and deadly garden grows.

quotes.name: Wild Growth
quotes.flavor:
"Here in Fyndhorn, where Freyalise's power is strongest, the forest has its own opinion."
—Laina of the Elvish Council

quotes.name: Surrender Your Thoughts
quotes.flavor: "Or, if you prefer, just surrender."

quotes.name: Poison-Tip Archer
quotes.flavor: "One more step and you're mine."

quotes.name: Deathgazer
quotes.flavor: Your entire life passes before its eyes.

quotes.name: Death Speakers
quotes.flavor:
"The dead may be beyond the law, but speaking the wisdom of the dead will afford no protection!"
—Calmont, Aysen bureaucrat

quotes.name: Zhalfirin Void
quotes.flavor:
"The wind whispers, 'come home,' but I cannot."
—Teferi

quotes.name: Ichor Shade
quotes.flavor: As oil seeped into their funeral shrouds, Tolvada's dead rose to join the invaders' ranks.

quotes.name: Canopy Vista
quotes.flavor: Chuuy Kaaj, "The Hanging City," has endured for centuries as the thriving hub of Malamet art, life, and culture.

quotes.name: Dominate
quotes.flavor:
"I've come to reclaim what is mine. And you, Greven, are mine."
—Volrath

quotes.name: Standstill
quotes.flavor:
"You learn a lot in no time when you're about to get your neck snapped."
—Dack Fayden

quotes.name: Gearseeker Serpent
quotes.flavor: Its collection is vast, yet each ship has a special place in its heart.

quotes.name: Cyclopean Snare
quotes.flavor: The spoiled, gluttonous halls of the Orzhov teem with gaudy, needless wealth. Even their security measures are made for beauty first, efficiency second.

quotes.name: Ancient Den
quotes.flavor: Taj-Nar, throne of Raksha Golden Cub, destined leader of the leonin prides.

quotes.name: Diresight
quotes.flavor: Avatar Roku showed Aang the truth behind Sozin's Comet.

quotes.name: Scarscale Ritual
quotes.flavor: Some words are too important to trust to something as fragile as memory.

quotes.name: Kaalia of the Vast
quotes.flavor: In the vast emptiness, Kaalia found she was not alone.

quotes.name: Aether Storm
quotes.flavor:
"I do love the rain . . . but this storm feels somehow wrong, Taysir."
—Daria

quotes.name: Greenseeker
quotes.flavor: "A rumor passes among the snakes, whispered by the rushes, inspiring the seekers: the goddess Freyalise is alive in Skyshroud."

quotes.name: Safewright Cavalry
quotes.flavor: They had survived battles and foes together. For the elf, there was no greater beauty than her cervin steed.

quotes.name: Arrester's Admonition
quotes.flavor: Law is the voice of reason.

quotes.name: Manglehorn
quotes.flavor:
"Rely too much on your weapons and watch your dreams shatter in your hands."
—Rhonas, god of strength

quotes.name: Island
quotes.flavor: In crystal-studded waters far below the surface, you've discovered an incubating egg of mysterious origin.

quotes.name: Darting Merfolk
quotes.flavor: You might as well try to catch water with a net.

quotes.name: Everett K. Ross, Hapless Attaché
quotes.flavor: Everett learned from his experiences escorting Wakandan royalty. This time he brought a bigger car and an extra pair of pants.

quotes.name: Linvala, Keeper of Silence
quotes.flavor: Those who seek to disturb the harmony of life will see their instruments taken from them.

quotes.name: Miirym, Sentinel Wyrm
quotes.flavor: The most terrifying thing a dragon can be is well-read.

quotes.name: Stench of Decay
quotes.flavor:
"My lord, there is only so much I can do. This plague infests Krov worse than any other city."
—Halvor Arensson, Kjeldoran Priest

quotes.name: Homicide Investigator
quotes.flavor: In her line of work, the dead are often better sources than the living.

quotes.name: Synapse Sliver
quotes.flavor:
"Species XR17 feeds upon the mental energies of its victims. This explains why the goblins remain unaffected."
—Riptide Project researcher

quotes.name: Big Score
quotes.flavor: "Unimaginable riches? I assure you, I have a *vivid* imagination."

quotes.name: Adarkar Wastes
quotes.flavor: Left barren by the Brothers' War, it stands as a stark reminder of Dominaria's likely fate should the Coalition fail.

quotes.name: Adriana, Captain of the Guard
quotes.flavor: "My sword is pledged to the defense of this city, not to the throne or this usurper."

quotes.name: Sylvan Ranger
quotes.flavor: "Not all paths are found on the forest floor."

quotes.name: Scroll of Avacyn
quotes.flavor: Words to bless the eye that reads them, telling of a future beyond the reach of fear.

quotes.name: Glimpse the Unthinkable
quotes.flavor:
"I am confident that if anyone actually penetrates our facades, even the most perceptive would still be fundamentally unprepared for the truth of House Dimir."
—Szadek

quotes.name: Ancient Grudge
quotes.flavor: If there's anything a werewolf hates, it's a collar—especially Avacyn's Collar, the symbol of her church.

quotes.name: Righteousness
quotes.flavor:
"I too shall be brought low by death, but until then let me win glory."
—Homer, *Iliad, Book XVIII*

quotes.name: Goretusk Firebeast
quotes.flavor: As a youth, Kamahl took one for a pet. His hair has yet to grow back.

quotes.name: Stocking the Pantry
quotes.flavor:
Sorting the seeds from the nuts
—Squirrelfolk expression meaning
"dwelling on unnecessary details"

quotes.name: Azorius Guildgate
quotes.flavor: Enter the Senate, the seat of justice and the foundation of Ravnican society.

quotes.name: Chance Encounter
quotes.flavor: The more unlikely the victory, the more memorable the success.

quotes.name: Éomer, Marshal of Rohan
quotes.flavor: "Need brooks no delay, yet late is better than never."

quotes.name: Chastise
quotes.flavor:
"Why do we pray to the Ancestor? Because She listens."
—Mystic elder

quotes.name: Bone Shaman
quotes.flavor:
Rattle me bones as I cross the floor
And the bones in your grave will rattle no more.

quotes.name: Argentum Armor
quotes.flavor: Mirrodin's creator still lives, still shapes metal, and still commands world-shaking power.

quotes.name: Archaeomancer
quotes.flavor: "Words of power never disappear. They sleep, awaiting those with the will to rouse them."

quotes.name: Brain Pry
quotes.flavor: To the Rakdos, the fun is in the shakedown. The loot is usually discarded.

quotes.name: Overgrown Farmland
quotes.flavor:
"Animals have ruled this planet for millions of years. Now it is our turn."
—Harrison Chase

quotes.name: Mystical Tutor
quotes.flavor: "It's not just what you know. It's knowing where to find what you don't."

quotes.name: Urza, Prince of Kroog
quotes.flavor: The prince consort was happy to let Yotia's coffers fund his extravagant research.

quotes.name: Confront the Past
quotes.flavor: "Why, Gideon? Of all people, why save me?"

quotes.name: Wall of Bone
quotes.flavor: The Wall of Bone is said to be an aspect of the Great Wall in Hel, where the bones of all sinners wait for Ragnarok, when Hela will call them forth for the final battle.

quotes.name: Wight of Precinct Six
quotes.flavor: Even the lost and undead need a protector.

quotes.name: Clarion Conqueror
quotes.flavor: All challengers were summarily silenced.

quotes.name: Bazaar Trader
quotes.flavor: "No need for a hurda? How about these maps to recently discovered tombs? Or these vials of invisible potion? Very fancy . . ."

quotes.name: Ghostway
quotes.flavor:
"I watched its blade swing through me, but I was hollow, empty. I saw its face contort in rage but could not hear it snarl."
—Klattic, Boros legionnaire

quotes.name: Wayfarer's Bauble
quotes.flavor: "Treasure, treasure!"

quotes.name: Grave Titan
quotes.flavor: Death in form and function.

quotes.name: Tormented Thoughts
quotes.flavor:
"Not all nightmares can be escaped by waking."
—Ashiok, Nightmare Weaver

quotes.name: The Legend of Kyoshi // Avatar Kyoshi
quotes.flavor: "Only justice will bring peace."

quotes.name: Storm the Citadel
quotes.flavor:
"If we die, we die. But we cannot let him win."
—Ajani Goldmane

quotes.name: Forge of Heroes
quotes.flavor: History is not delicately woven. It is hammered with fire.

quotes.name: Quicken
quotes.flavor: A skilled Izzet chronarch can carry out an epic vendetta between the fall of one hourglass grain and the next.

quotes.name: Smile at Death
quotes.flavor:
"Khan Alesha ensured our survival. Now we will forge our future."
—Zurgo, khan of the Mardu

quotes.name: Splendid Reclamation
quotes.flavor:
"These seeds waited faithfully for the sun to rise again. Now, their patience is rewarded."
—Wrenn

quotes.name: Prismabasher
quotes.flavor: Driven by an unknown hunger, it charges from aurora to aurora leaving trails of wild magic in its wake.

quotes.name: Quandrix Apprentice
quotes.flavor: "The secrets of our world will be mine."

quotes.name: Elvish Mariner
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor: In the days of the Kings, most of the High Elves dwelt with Círdan or in the seaward lands of Lindon.

quotes.name: Shimmerwing Chimera
quotes.flavor: It swims upon the winds and soars through the waves.

quotes.name: Arc Lightning
quotes.flavor: Rainclouds don't last long in Shiv, but that doesn't stop the lightning.

quotes.name: Eshki Dragonclaw
quotes.flavor: "The Twice Whisperer heals. The Dragonclaw protects. Together, we will rebuild the Temur."

quotes.name: Nighthaze
quotes.flavor:
"To evade the brood lineages, one must be made dark to all the senses."
—Traga, Zulaport runner

quotes.name: Diabolic Edict
quotes.flavor:
"Always give your foes a choice when they have none."
—Ob Nixilis

quotes.name: Wild Hunger
quotes.flavor: Otto the Hunter was filled with many grand ambitions. The snake was filled only with Otto.

quotes.name: Into the Maw of Hell
quotes.flavor: Few entrances lead to where demons and devils lurk. Unfortunately, they occasionally open new ones.

quotes.name: Pernicious Deed
quotes.flavor:
"The tyrannous and bloody deed is done,
The most arch deed of piteous massacre
That ever yet this land was guilty of."
—William Shakespeare, *Richard III*

quotes.name: Deadly Tempest
quotes.flavor: When the winds blow out of the abyss, death is the only harvest.

quotes.name: Swords to Plowshares
quotes.flavor: The smallest seed of regret can bloom into redemption.

quotes.name: Maestros Diabolist
quotes.flavor: "Where did I find my horned friend? Now there's a story worth telling. . . ."

quotes.name: Negate
quotes.flavor: Masters of the arcane savor a delicious irony. Their study of deep and complex arcana leads to such a simple end: the ability to say merely yes or no.

quotes.name: Armored Ascension
quotes.flavor: With skill and strength honed upon the prairie, Naxtil won his battles high above it.

quotes.name: Marauding Blight-Priest
quotes.flavor: "The vampires never had gods. We followed our bloodchiefs. Now they are gone. What is left? Destruction and death, my friends. That is enough."

quotes.name: Birds of Paradise
quotes.flavor: Its brilliant plumage painted streaks of color across a sky long darkened by war.

quotes.name: Skyshaper
quotes.flavor:
"It'll get us to the portal, but I can't guarantee what it'll do to the ship."
—Hanna, *Weatherlight* navigator

quotes.name: Karador, Ghost Chieftain
quotes.flavor: "Death tried to uncrown me. But now I return, king of a greater realm."

quotes.name: Felidar Savior
quotes.flavor: Cut and bruised from his climb to the summit, Zahr wept with relief when he saw the felidar's horns appear.

quotes.name: Sulfurous Blast
quotes.flavor: The Keldons used the toxic vents in the cracked earth to bolster their home's defenses.

quotes.name: Magmatic Insight
quotes.flavor: Chief among the tenets of Purphoros is that one must destroy in order to create.

quotes.name: Spitting Earth
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks Anthology: Elves vs. Goblins
quotes.flavor:
"Within each of you is the strength of a landslide."
—Kumano, to his pupils

quotes.name: Blightstep Pathway // Searstep Pathway
quotes.flavor:
"The waters smell oddly sweet, but do not be enticed. You don't want to meet what lurks below the surface."
—Solrun, Beskir warrior

quotes.name: Valeron Outlander
quotes.flavor: After years of honing her philosophy in debate with stubborn rhoxes, Niella was ready to convert any heathen.

quotes.name: River Boa
quotes.flavor:
"But no one heard the snake's gentle hiss for peace over the elephant's trumpeting of war."
—Afari, *Tales*

quotes.name: Wall of Blossoms
quotes.flavor: Each flower identical, every leaf and petal disturbingly exact.

quotes.name: Cabal Ritual
quotes.flavor:
"Each syllable chills your veins. Each word rattles your mind."
—Cabal Patriarch

quotes.name: Thoughtcast
quotes.flavor: Vedalken eyes don't see the beauty in things. They see only what those things can teach.

quotes.name: Ballot Broker
quotes.flavor:
"Merchants and politicians differ only in name."
—Queen Marchesa

quotes.name: Horseshoe Crab
quotes.flavor:
"Hmm . . . It looks kinda like a bug. Let's crack it open an' see if it tastes like one!"
—Squee, goblin cabin hand

quotes.name: Clam-I-Am
quotes.flavor:
The Clams down in Clamville
All scootered and skittled—
"The three is no more!"
The Clam fiddler fiddled.

quotes.name: Rakdos Signet
quotes.flavor: Made of bone and boiled in blood, a Rakdos signet is not considered finished until it has been used as a murder weapon.

quotes.name: Cone of Flame
quotes.flavor:
"Mine is not the warmth of compassion."
—Ertai, wizard adept

quotes.name: Traveling Minister
quotes.flavor: Priests of the Sigardian Sect travel to the farthest reaches to spread hope and healing, even in the darkest times.

quotes.name: Dauntless Veteran
quotes.flavor: "Courage is not the absence of fear. Courage is choosing to face your fear, spit in its face, and refuse to let it hold you back."

quotes.name: Moment's Peace
quotes.flavor: Their minds filled with quiet, their hearts with love.

quotes.name: Zuko, Exiled Prince
quotes.flavor: "I want the Avatar. I want my honor, my throne."

quotes.name: Scout for Survivors
quotes.flavor:
"We've received transmission! They're alive—just barely."
—Sunstar Free Company Mission Control

quotes.name: Water Wings
quotes.flavor: Luckily for the plummeting Johann, the hydroloft spell was one he had actually mastered.

quotes.name: Citizen's Arrest
quotes.flavor: "What lurks behind the faces of those you think you can trust?"

quotes.name: Nimrodel Watcher
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor:
"But there are some of us still who go abroad for the gathering of news and the watching of our enemies."
—Haldir

quotes.name: Choose Your Demise
quotes.flavor: "There is no way out—only a choice of final agonies."

quotes.name: Bonepicker Skirge
quotes.flavor: Even the most insignificant creature can be perfected.

quotes.name: Keen Sense
quotes.flavor: Crovax sensed that Mirri wasn't ready for the curse taking hold of her. Weeping in his heart, he fled.

quotes.name: Wall of Fire
quotes.flavor: Conjured from the bowels of hell, the fiery wall forms an impassable barrier, searing the soul of any creature attempting to pass through its terrible bursts of flame.

quotes.name: Beast in Show
quotes.flavor: "Not a surprise to see her on the podium. This paragon of tusk curvature is just the latest addition to the long championship lineage of Wildspeaker Ranch."

quotes.name: Death's-Head Buzzard
quotes.flavor: Infested with vermin, ever hungering, dropping from night's sky.

quotes.name: Negate
quotes.flavor:
"You cannot be an Ojutai monk. They prize wisdom and skill, and you have neither."
—Siara, the Dragon's Mouth

quotes.name: Spore Frog
quotes.flavor: Gromp spores can be distilled into a variety of powerful chemical agents, or added to tea for a disastrous afternoon in the city.

quotes.name: Abyssal Horror
quotes.flavor: It has no face of its own—it wears that of its latest victim.

quotes.name: Morbid Curiosity
quotes.flavor: "Every creation carries a piece of its creators. Their knowledge, their dreams, their soul. That is the best part."

quotes.name: Wind Drake
quotes.flavor:
"No bird soars too high, if he soars with his own wings."
—William Blake,
*The Marriage of Heaven and Hell*

quotes.name: Falkenrath Noble
quotes.flavor: "I often think on how excited they must feel to be chosen as my prey."

quotes.name: Transmutation
quotes.flavor:
"You know what I was,/ You see what I am: change me, change me!"
—Randall Jarrell, *The Woman at the Washington Zoo*

quotes.name: Council's Judgment
quotes.flavor: When its power is threatened, the council speaks with a unified voice.

quotes.name: Sol Ring
quotes.flavor:
Sué wanders the sky, hoping to steal a
glance at his love Chia. When we see them
reunite, it is a time for celebration.

quotes.name: Talisman of Conviction
quotes.flavor: Grognak. Silver Shroud. Manta Man. Mistress of Mystery. The Inspector. The heroes united together to become ... The Unstoppables.

quotes.name: Relic Runner
quotes.flavor: Her knack for tampering with wards got her kicked out of the academy, but they also got her back in.

quotes.name: Spirit Link
quotes.flavor: "I am bound to all my children. I share in their joys, I rage at their injuries."

quotes.name: Thundermare
quotes.flavor: Its hooves strike lightning and the thunder follows quickly after.

quotes.name: Brainstorm
quotes.flavor: James would let his duck compose now and then, but never make the tea!

quotes.name: Angel's Tomb
quotes.flavor:
"Faith can quicken the stones themselves with life."
—Writings of Mikaeus

quotes.name: Mesa Falcon
quotes.flavor:
"The faith of Serra is borne on wings of hope."
—Gulsen, abbey matron

quotes.name: Field Surgeon
quotes.flavor: Commanders order soldiers to attack. Field surgeons order them to heal. Both are obeyed without question.

quotes.name: Nurgle's Rot
quotes.flavor: Each plaguebearer is formed from the blighted soul of a mortal slain by Nurgle's Rot.

quotes.name: Burning Wish
quotes.flavor: She wished for a weapon, but not for the skill to wield it.

quotes.name: Sewer-veillance Cam
quotes.flavor: No one in New York was going to notice one more cockroach.

quotes.name: Deceptive Frostkite
quotes.flavor:
"That's not a dragon. Can't be. It's too small, isn't it?"
—Askar, Temur scout, last words

quotes.name: Divine Transformation
quotes.flavor: Glory surged through her and radiance surrounded her. All things were possible with the blessing of the Divine.

quotes.name: Lich-Knights' Conquest
quotes.flavor: In their rotting minds, they still quest for virtue and glory.

quotes.name: Shattered Sanctum
quotes.flavor:
"The most cordial words are often the ones intended to deceive. It's only of late that I've realized how much strength honesty requires."
—Embrose, dean of shadow

quotes.name: Blur
quotes.flavor: "It's as much a trick of the mind as it is a trick of the eye."

quotes.name: Crackle with Power
quotes.flavor: Will gasped as Rowan drew from the raw power of the Strixhaven Snarl. For a moment, she was luminous, transcendent, terrible.

quotes.name: Maja, Bretagard Protector
quotes.flavor: "Our enemies have breached our realm. To survive, the clans must fight as one!"

quotes.name: Phyrexian Rager
quotes.flavor:
"I believe many worlds will bow to Phyrexia. Mirrodin is merely the first."
—Sheoldred, Whispering One

quotes.name: Chandra's Embercat
quotes.flavor:
"Furballs? Try dealing with fireballs."
—Chandra Nalaar

quotes.name: Evra, Halcyon Witness
quotes.flavor:
"Light from the Null Moon took form—a mirage made real, alone in grandeur, isolated in a world that once had been its own."
—*Fall of the Thran*

quotes.name: Selesnya Signet
quotes.flavor: The symbol of the Conclave is one of unity, with tree supporting sun and sun feeding tree.

quotes.name: Thornwood Falls
quotes.flavor: Deep in Eldraine's wilds, strange eyelike appendages twined among the vines and faerie lights.

quotes.name: Voldaren Bloodcaster // Bloodbat Summoner
quotes.flavor: "Humans throw rice and release doves at their weddings? How quaint."

quotes.name: Release the Dogs
quotes.flavor: They charge into battle and out for their morning walk with the same exuberance.

quotes.name: Sure Strike
quotes.flavor: "I packed three more electroconduits into each test wand. You'll experience a brief tingling sensation."

quotes.name: Balduvian Barbarians
quotes.flavor:
"From the snowy slopes of Kaelor,
To the canyons of Bandu,
We drink and fight and feast and die
As we were born to do."
—Balduvian tavern song

quotes.name: Turn to Dust
quotes.flavor: Mirrodin's inhabitants must be prepared for anything—including suddenly being unprepared.

quotes.name: Pathbreaker Ibex
quotes.flavor:
"Not only a wrecking ball, but a trendsetter in its own right."
—Crocodile Jackson, legendary cowboy

quotes.name: Warren Soultrader
quotes.flavor: "The living take their souls for granted. The dead know what they're worth."

quotes.name: Arden Angel
quotes.flavor: Cast from dreams and forged in hope.

quotes.name: North Wind Avatar
quotes.flavor: The Path of the Four Winds is a quest for knowledge. South to the serpent. West to the Jaguar. North to the dragon. East to the eagle.

quotes.name: Nymris, Oona's Trickster
quotes.flavor: Mischief is its own reward.

quotes.name: Savannah Sage
quotes.flavor: "Now is not the time for your light to fade."

quotes.name: Master of Etherium
quotes.flavor: "Only a mind unfettered with the concerns of the flesh can see the world as it truly is."

quotes.name: Might of the Old Ways
quotes.flavor: Brimming with power from their disrupted ritual, the Dawnhart witches lashed out at the werewolf intruders.

quotes.name: Sigiled Behemoth
quotes.flavor:
"Do not mistake a behemoth's assistance for subservience."
—Mayael the Anima

quotes.name: Squee, Goblin Nabob
quotes.flavor:
"Some goblins are expendable. Some are impossible to get rid of. But he's both—at the same time!"
—Starke

quotes.name: Mourning Thrull
quotes.flavor: During their ascent to spirithood, patriarchs of Orzhova shed both flesh and emotion. This earthly slag is collected and formed into thrulls.

quotes.name: Kragma Warcaller
quotes.flavor: A warcaller merely brings the herd together. After that, the meat-hunger is all the encouragement they need.

quotes.name: Moment of Glory
quotes.flavor: "I am Bard, slayer of the Dragon!"

quotes.name: Ghost Quarter
quotes.flavor: Where wasted life cries out to be reborn.

quotes.name: Smallpox
quotes.flavor:
"Great losses often bring only a numb shock. To truly plunge a victim into misery, you must overwhelm them with many small sufferings."
—Ratadrabik of Urborg

quotes.name: Collector Ouphe
quotes.flavor:
"He steals power from treasure after treasure, and what does it do for the ouphe? Nothing."
—Jhoira

quotes.name: Heavy Infantry
quotes.flavor: Doors, walls, skulls . . . it matters not. All barriers will be broken.

quotes.name: Karplusan Forest
quotes.flavor: Between jagged, snowcapped peaks, the dense bands of hardy evergreens provide the perfect cover for roving bands of orc and goblin raiders.

quotes.name: Unifying Theory
quotes.flavor: Scribbles of a lunatic and formulas of a genius are often indistinguishable.

quotes.name: Pacifism
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks Anthology: Divine vs. Demonic
quotes.flavor: Even those born to battle could only lay their blades at Akroma's feet.

quotes.name: Rustvine Cultivator
quotes.flavor: Feel the joy of losing yourself to feed the land.

quotes.name: Quilled Slagwurm
quotes.flavor: Vorinclex removed its teeth so it wouldn't waste time chewing before moving to the next kill.

quotes.name: Took Reaper
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor: The Tooks came, a hundred strong, from Tuckborough and the Green Hills.

quotes.name: Shaman of the Pack
quotes.flavor: To the elves, her spear is a compass; to the boggarts, a harbinger of doom.

quotes.name: Fact or Fiction
quotes.flavor: "Slimefoot, I know I said I wanted to grow our repository of knowledge, but this isn't what I had in mind."

quotes.name: Ecstatic Beauty
quotes.flavor: "Try to see what I see. We are so lucky we are still alive to see this beautiful world."

quotes.name: Corrupted Harvester
quotes.flavor:
"Before the blessed assault begins, we must seek specimens that are well-adapted to our way of . . . life."
—Sheoldred, Whispering One

quotes.name: Wedding Security
quotes.flavor: In lieu of payment, he was granted permission to devour any unauthorized visitors.

quotes.name: Fellwar Stone
quotes.flavor:
"What do you have that I cannot obtain?"
—Mairsil, the Pretender

quotes.name: Mystic of the Hidden Way
quotes.flavor: "There are many different paths. The Great Teacher reveals them all."

quotes.name: Lash of Malice
quotes.flavor:
"The strongest shadow spells come from disdain for someone else, not frustration with yourself."
—Embrose, Silverquill dean

quotes.name: Uncharted Haven
quotes.flavor:
"There are lands beyond Valley. Wild, calamity-scarred, and beautiful."
—Farfeather, birdfolk scout

quotes.name: Kwain, Itinerant Meddler
quotes.flavor: "Invite your friends! Invite your family! Invite some strangers! Tonight we feast!"

quotes.name: Peregrine Drake
quotes.flavor: That the Tolarian mists parted for the drakes was warning enough to stay away.

quotes.name: Bonds of Quicksilver
quotes.flavor: The sea's reach extends beyond its shores.

quotes.name: Took Reaper
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor: The Tooks came, a hundred strong, from Tuckborough and the Green Hills.

quotes.name: Heroic Intervention
quotes.flavor:
"Wherever the strong would harm the weak, I will be there."
—Ajani Goldmane

quotes.name: Shivan Dragon
quotes.flavor: While it's true most Dragons are cruel, the Shivan Dragon seems to take particular glee in the misery of others, often tormenting its victims much like a cat plays with a mouse before delivering the final blow.

quotes.name: Ludevic, Necro-Alchemist
quotes.flavor: "How does one become a self-taught genius? Naturally, it requires brains."

quotes.name: Madame Null, Power Broker
quotes.flavor: "We suffered a bit of a setback tonight, but rest assured: We'll have the planet purged and primed for you right on schedule."

quotes.name: Simic Guildgate
quotes.flavor: Simic biomancers don't concern themselves with guarding a gate. Their ever-present creations are enough to ward off trespassers.

quotes.name: Bloodline Necromancer
quotes.flavor: "The veil of death hides little from our kind."

quotes.name: Myr Quadropod
quotes.flavor: Each myr was designed to fill a specific role. This one, for example, was designed to stomp on other myr.

quotes.name: Steel Sabotage
quotes.flavor:
"You are hopelessly obsolete, my brothers. Come and join the Great Work."
—Rhmir, Hand of the Augur

quotes.name: Akroma's Vengeance
quotes.flavor: Ixidor had only to imagine their ruin and Akroma made it so.

quotes.name: Selhoff Occultist
quotes.flavor: "The mist whispers to those who know it to be more than a mundane fog."

quotes.name: Dispatch
quotes.flavor: "Structural weakness detected. Exploiting."

quotes.name: Gerrard, Weatherlight Hero
quotes.flavor: Gerrard's final act ensured his legacy would never die.

quotes.name: Chromatic Sphere
quotes.flavor:
"As expected, this sphere's design reflects the colors of the four moons . . . plus another?"
—Pontifex, elder researcher

quotes.name: Vryn Wingmare
quotes.flavor: It's the favored mount of military commanders as well as anyone with a flair for the dramatic.

quotes.name: Two-Headed Cerberus
quotes.flavor: The left head keeps the right head starved as motivation to track new prey.

quotes.name: Firebreathing
quotes.flavor: "And topples round the dreary west A looming bastion fringed with fire." —Alfred, Lord Tennyson, "In Memoriam"

quotes.name: Vampire Sovereign
quotes.flavor:
"Your service shall be rewarded."
—Queen Lian

quotes.name: Wilt-Leaf Cavaliers
quotes.flavor: Every elf in Shadowmoor is charged from birth with a terrible duty: to strike back against the ugliness and darkness, even though they are all around and seemingly without end.

quotes.name: Dimir Signet
quotes.flavor: An emblem of a secret guild, the Dimir insignia is seen only by its own members-and the doomed.

quotes.name: Stomping Ground
quotes.flavor:
"Neural's active mantle and energetic water cycle create staggeringly beautiful rock formations and a variety of tropical microclimates. Don't feed the wildlife."
—*Lawmim Galactopedia*

quotes.name: Xira Arien
quotes.flavor: A regular guest at the Royal Masquerade, Arien is the envy of the Court. She appears in a new costume every hour.

quotes.name: Flame Elemental
quotes.flavor: Storyteller: By my hand in the fire, this story is a tale of power. Listeners: May it give you strength.

quotes.name: Daru Spiritualist
quotes.flavor: He lifts the spirits of his people so they may descend in wrath upon their foes.

quotes.name: Invigorating Surge
quotes.flavor: For hydras, most problems can be solved with the addition of a few extra heads.

quotes.name: Avatar of Slaughter
quotes.flavor:
"Diplomacy has solved nothing. Only bloodspill can end this now. Call forth the warbringer."
—Basandra, Battle Seraph

quotes.name: Gogo, Master of Mimicry
quotes.flavor: "I see... so, you seek to save the world. Then I guess that means I shall save the world as well. Lead on! I will copy your every move."

quotes.name: Thopter Foundry
quotes.flavor:
"Etherium is limited. Innovation is not."
—Tezzeret

quotes.name: Release to the Wind
quotes.flavor: "Here and gone like a fleeting breeze."

quotes.name: Golgari Signet
quotes.set_name: Phyrexia: All Will Be One Commander
quotes.flavor: Depending on your point of view, the seal represents a proud guardian of the natural cycle or one who has sold her soul to darkness for eternal life.

quotes.name: Locust Spray
quotes.flavor:
「鎧の質は継ぎ目次第。」
――「虚栄の迷路：騎士の愚行」

quotes.name: Swat
quotes.flavor: Few who cross Phage have the chance to repeat the mistake.

quotes.name: Eternal Warrior
quotes.flavor: Warriors of the Tsunami-nito School spend years in training to master the way of effortless effort.

quotes.name: Grenzo, Dungeon Warden
quotes.flavor: CAN BE BRIBED. CAN'T BE TRUSTED.

quotes.name: Verdant Force
quotes.flavor: The bower shuddered. The stillness broke. The scurf shifted, and a being emerged from the flowers and ferns.

quotes.name: Cauldron Familiar
quotes.flavor:
"When the cat thinks I'm asleep, I can hear him whispering in the kitchen . . ."
—Recovered audio log, entry 81

quotes.name: Deeproot Warrior
quotes.flavor:
"We breathe from our soul and bones to give strength to the jungle. The jungle breathes from its roots and rivers to give strength to us."
—Shaper Falani

quotes.name: Titan Hunter
quotes.flavor: "Monster or human, my rate's the same."

quotes.name: Bog Imp
quotes.flavor: Don't be fooled by their looks. Think of them as little knives with wings.

quotes.name: Prize Pig
quotes.flavor: The habit of building farmhouses and barns began among the inhabitants of the Marish down by the Brandywine.

quotes.name: Kiora of Fire and Ashes
quotes.flavor: "If you can't stand the heat, get out of my way."

quotes.name: Null Profusion
quotes.flavor:
"Some say that time is cyclical and that history inevitably repeats. My will is my own. I won't bow to fate."
—Volrath

quotes.name: Whisper of the Dross
quotes.flavor: "Live or die, you serve the Steel Thanes now."

quotes.name: Isshin, Two Heavens as One
quotes.flavor: Trained by the Imperials but disillusioned by their rigidity, he gave his heart—and his swords—to the Asari Uprising.

quotes.name: Sheoldred's Edict
quotes.flavor: "Congratulations. I am entertained."

quotes.name: Necrotic Ooze
quotes.flavor:
"To death all must go, and so in death lies ultimate power."
—Geth, Lord of the Vault

quotes.name: Fungusaur
quotes.flavor: Rather than sheltering her young, the female Fungusaur often injures her own offspring, thereby ensuring their rapid growth.

quotes.name: Ravenous Slime
quotes.flavor: Death eventually wiggles toward us all.

quotes.name: Youthful Knight
quotes.flavor:
"Let no child be without a sword. We will all fight, for if we fail, we will certainly all die."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

quotes.name: Elvish Piper
quotes.flavor:
From Gaea grew the world, and the world was silent. From Gaea grew the world's elves, and the world was silent no more.
—Elvish teaching

quotes.name: Greater Good
quotes.flavor:
"There's wisdom to be gained in death—whether it be one's own or someone else's."
—Jarad, Golgari Lich-Lord

quotes.name: Inspiring Statuary
quotes.flavor: Ghirapur's most celebrated inventors have been immortalized in clockwork.

quotes.name: Dune Mover
quotes.flavor: The shifting, unpredictable sands were deemed a disobedient affront to the Flesh Singularity.

quotes.name: Etali, Primal Storm
quotes.flavor: The storm rages and the earth breaks.

quotes.name: Ruthless Deathfang
quotes.flavor:
"Bring forth the dead, their skull-grins and rattle-bones. We will feast upon their wailing ghosts."
—Silumgar, translated from Draconic

quotes.name: Manamorphose
quotes.flavor: For a moment, objects of pure mana glimmered in the wonderstruck boggart's hands. In the next moment, they were in his mouth, as he chewed contentedly.

quotes.name: Intelligence Bobblehead
quotes.flavor: Bobbleheads were once an exclusive perk for Vault-Tec executives and residential vault dwellers.

quotes.name: Elvish Lyrist
Brawn
quotes.flavor:
"'I have arrived,' bellowed Brawn, and the plane shuddered."
—Scroll of Beginnings

quotes.name: Spire of Industry
quotes.flavor: Atop the tallest tower in the Commonwealth resides Fist, the leader of the super mutants, and his prized prisoners: Strong and Rex.

quotes.name: Cryptic Command
quotes.flavor: Predict the future, survey the past, then choose wisely thy spell to cast.

quotes.name: Feeding Frenzy
quotes.flavor: It wasn't as much a strategy as a dim instinct to drown their prey.

quotes.name: Demonmail Hauberk
quotes.flavor: It comes off as easily as your own skin.

quotes.name: Hinder
quotes.flavor:
"Do not react to force in kind. Turn it aside. Direct it to where it can do no harm."
—Meloku the Clouded Mirror

quotes.name: Slimy Dualleech
quotes.flavor:
"Isn't it gorgeous? It's my most efficient corpse eliminator! One head bites while the other chews."
—Glogus, Golgari leechbreeder

quotes.name: Glen Elendra Liege
quotes.flavor: Those who displease Oona soon learn the extent of the armies she commands.

quotes.name: Archdemon of Unx
quotes.flavor: The necropolis at Unx was once a living city, its streets untrodden by death.

quotes.name: Dragon Blood
quotes.flavor: A single drop turns skin to scale and fist to claw.

quotes.name: Mistmeadow Witch
quotes.flavor: Olka collected the evening mist for years, studying its secrets. Once she learned its essence, she could vanish with a thought.

quotes.name: Willow Priestess
quotes.flavor:
"Those of faith are those of strength."
—Autumn Willow

quotes.name: Hero's Blade
quotes.flavor: The best swords are forged with dragonfire.

quotes.name: Kitesail Corsair
quotes.flavor: "Why perch in the crow's nest when I can fly like the crows?"

quotes.name: Fell
quotes.flavor: When Glarb ordered the egg stolen, the Great Maha communicated its anger in a universal language.

quotes.name: Radiate
quotes.flavor:
"See? I'd never leave my friends hangin'!"
—Rainbow Dash

quotes.name: Line Cutter
quotes.flavor: Waiting is for chumps with flimsy spacesuits.

quotes.name: Carnivorous Moss-Beast
quotes.flavor: Ranger wisdom dictates that when fleeing from a moss-beast, you must stay calm, find your bearings, and run south.

quotes.name: Pierce the Sky
quotes.flavor: Llanowar elves conceal their ballistae in the upper canopy of the forest, ready to clear the skies of any intruder.

quotes.name: Devoted Duelist
quotes.flavor: "Arrows? Ha! Wood and feather? Toys!"

quotes.name: Primeval Herald
quotes.flavor: When they call, nature answers.

quotes.name: Mythos of Brokkos
quotes.flavor:
"The most unexpected weapon that a monster can wield is kindness."
—*Tales of the Ozolith*

quotes.name: Forced Adaptation
quotes.flavor:
"We're planting the seeds of change. Sometimes, we plant them in people."
—Vorel of the Hull Clade

quotes.name: Collar the Culprit
quotes.flavor:
"Reports of Gruul rioters in four districts. Start with the big ones and work your way up."
—Libuse, Boros sergeant

quotes.name: Fangorn, Tree Shepherd
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor: "I am an Ent. Fangorn is my name according to some, Treebeard others make it."

quotes.name: Dragon Mage
quotes.flavor: "I've forgotten more spells than you will ever know."

quotes.name: Valley Mightcaller
quotes.flavor: "There is no path to the Root Maze's center. Bard, sing a song while I create one."

quotes.name: Diresight
quotes.flavor: There is a fine line between predicting the future and causing it.

quotes.name: Homeward Path
quotes.flavor:
"Let your heels point you home."
—Ancient blessing

quotes.name: Gateway Plaza
quotes.flavor: Guild leaders focused their magic on the portal scar. Where the Chamber perished, a parun could be reborn.

quotes.name: Kami of the Crescent Moon
quotes.flavor:
"He's a lot like me, that masterless little kami . . . unimpressed by grandeur and never at a loss for a trick."
—Toshiro Umezawa

quotes.name: Aang, A Lot to Learn
quotes.flavor: "First you form a ball. Then you've got to get on quick!"

quotes.name: Exotic Orchard
quotes.flavor: Where the rainbow gets its colors and the sun finds its shine.

quotes.name: Umara Raptor
quotes.flavor: Messenger, weapon, friend.

quotes.name: Greater Werewolf
quotes.flavor:
"The wolf-things are no mere beasts, but the lieutenants of the Baron."
—Taysir

quotes.name: Essence Scatter
quotes.flavor: Algunos hechiceros compiten no por invocar las criaturas más interesantes, sino por crear los efectos más interesantes después de que la invocación sale mal.

quotes.name: Vile Rebirth
quotes.flavor:
"'Here lies our beloved Gartu, the gentlest of all men.' Ooh, I love irony."
—Jadar, ghoulcaller of Nephalia

quotes.name: Wild Beastmaster
quotes.flavor: "When they covered the world in city, all they did was give themselves nowhere to run."

quotes.name: Havengul Lich
quotes.flavor: Fusing intelligence with the power of undeath requires inspiration of the darkest kind.

quotes.name: Sengir Vampire
quotes.flavor: Empires rise and fall, but evil is eternal.

quotes.name: Blasphemous Act
quotes.flavor:
"Now watch as I do what you could not."
—Namor the Sub-Mariner

quotes.name: Counterspell
quotes.flavor: "How pathetic! To Doom, even your best efforts are an embarrassment!"

quotes.name: Serra Angel
quotes.flavor: Follow the light. In its absence, follow her.

quotes.name: Structural Assault
quotes.flavor: After the attack on the Vantoleone, the fragile balance of power shattered completely, and the city descended into chaos.

quotes.name: Lush Oasis
quotes.flavor:
"Finally, a stroke of luck! Had to taste the water myself to believe it wasn't a mirage."
—Pioneer journal of Big Ralph

quotes.name: Shadow Sliver
quotes.flavor: These slivers, trapped between worlds since the Rathi overlay, are among the last to claim direct lineage from the lost Sliver Queen.

quotes.name: Sudden Death
quotes.flavor: Some mages tapped into the time rifts, forcing upon others alternate timelines in which unimaginable horrors befall them.

quotes.name: Reputable Merchant
quotes.flavor: "Dried durian from the Marang River Valley! Candied cherries from the slopes of Cori! Genuine dragon scale cookware!"

quotes.name: Street Urchin
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: Your harsh upbringing on the streets of the city left you crafty, resilient, and wise beyond your years.

quotes.name: Thran Dynamo
quotes.flavor: Urza's metathran children were conceived, birthed, and nurtured by an integrated system of machines.

quotes.name: Tome of the Guildpact
quotes.flavor:
"Reading it has given me a glimpse of what makes this deeply flawed city so very magnificent."
—Dovin Baan

quotes.name: Mind's Dilation
quotes.flavor: Infinite wisdom cannot be contained within a single mind.

quotes.name: Seizan, Perverter of Truth
quotes.flavor:
"If you would taste the wisdom of the oni, be prepared to salt it with your blood."
—Kiku, Night's Flower

quotes.name: Stubborn Denial
quotes.flavor: The Temur have no patience for subtlety.

quotes.name: Malevolent Witchkite
quotes.flavor:
"Was there a fearsome witch around here? Or was it a cruel dragon? The tales were confu—oh no."
—Osval, adventurer

quotes.name: Dragon Fodder
quotes.flavor: Atarka goblins meet their demise as readily as their Temur counterparts did, but usually under big, winged shadows.

quotes.name: Genesis Chamber
quotes.flavor: "Andy! Please! I was only playing!"

quotes.name: Trip Wire
quotes.flavor: Trip wire, hooked poles, and sunken pits were commonly used to unhorse riders during the Three Kingdoms period.

quotes.name: Skyshroud Claim
quotes.flavor: "Flowstone spreads, but new life spreads faster."

quotes.name: Unsubstantiate
quotes.flavor:
"Nicely done, Jace. You always were good at disappearing acts."
—Liliana Vess

quotes.name: Tragic Slip
quotes.flavor: Linger on death's door and risk being invited in.

quotes.name: Detonate
quotes.flavor: The goblins have forty-two different words for "ow."

quotes.name: Floodfarm Verge
quotes.flavor: Here, the Mistmoors slump like a grieving parent, the once-thriving fields drowned by the relentless deluge.

quotes.name: Pristine Talisman
quotes.flavor:
"Tools and artisans can be destroyed, but the act of creation is inviolate."
—Elspeth Tirel

quotes.name: Butcher Ghoul
quotes.flavor: Without a mind, it doesn't fear death. Without a soul, it doesn't mind killing.

quotes.name: Terrifying Presence
quotes.flavor: Elmut had slaughtered vampires, slain werewolves, and destroyed hordes of zombies. Sadly, he never got over his fear of spiders.

quotes.name: Boartusk Liege
quotes.flavor: The boar leads its rider to victory in battle, but it doesn't know how close it is to becoming the victory feast.

quotes.name: Lethal Protection
quotes.flavor: Venom's favorite crime was punishment.

quotes.name: Hardened Scales
quotes.flavor: The wastes will toughen anybody up— even those who were already tough to begin with.

quotes.name: Commence the Endgame
quotes.flavor:
"Even gods shall kneel."
—Nicol Bolas

quotes.name: Wall of Spears
quotes.flavor:
"A stick is your friend. A pointed stick is your good friend. An army of pointed sticks is your best friend."
—Onean sergeant

quotes.name: Baleful Stare
quotes.flavor: "Though there is little to be learned from your dust and stones, I shall wring them dry nevertheless."

quotes.name: Satyr Hoplite
quotes.flavor: "Xenagos has become what he once despised: a tyrant and an oppressor."

quotes.name: Archmage of Runes
quotes.flavor: He's so intent on his study that others think him frozen in place.

quotes.name: Phyrexian Arena
quotes.flavor: All the might of Phyrexia was no match for this new, cuddly threat.

quotes.name: Murmuring Mystic
quotes.flavor: Rumors float through the city like crows, alighting on citizens seemingly at random.

quotes.name: Blighted Cataract
quotes.flavor: Once, water ran here. Now only dust and ash fall from the clifftops.

quotes.name: Novijen, Heart of Progress
quotes.flavor:
"The unnatural pressures of life in this city are best withstood by lifeforms that adapt with unnatural swiftness."
—Momir Vig

quotes.name: Lightning Helix
quotes.flavor: Though less well-known than its army of soldiers, the Boros Legion's mage-priests are as respected by the innocent as they are hated by the ghosts of the guilty.

quotes.name: Anger
quotes.flavor:
"For its time as a mortal, Anger chose a shell of boiling rock."
—*Scroll of Beginnings*

quotes.name: Fry
quotes.flavor:
"I'm afraid your dinner got a little . . . overcooked."
—Marlan Farthwald, innkeeper

quotes.name: Chaos Warp
quotes.flavor: The importance of using updated Pinnacle codebooks is a lesson learned only once.

quotes.name: Annie Joins Up
quotes.flavor: One last job, then she could retire in peace.

quotes.name: Vitalize
quotes.flavor:
"After waking to the magic of Llanowar, no dreams can compare."
—Mirri of the *Weatherlight*

quotes.name: Fleshtaker
quotes.flavor: A soulless husk of endless hunger.

quotes.name: Spur Grappler
quotes.flavor: Grapplers hunt in packs, driving their victims over steep mountain cliffs.

quotes.name: Ulcerate
quotes.flavor:
"If it were merely lethal, that would be sufficient. The art, however, is in maximizing the suffering it causes."
—Liliana Vess

quotes.name: Kjeldoran Dead
quotes.flavor:
"They shall drink sorrow's dregs. They shall kill those whom once they loved."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

quotes.name: Seaside Citadel
quotes.flavor: For wisdom's sake, it was built high to gaze on all things. For glory's sake, it was built high as a testament of power. For strength's sake, it was built high to repel all attacks.

quotes.name: Brightglass Gearhulk
quotes.flavor: "A new day dawns for Avishkar, and we shall draw our power from its light."

quotes.name: Glissa's Courier
quotes.flavor:
"So, the survivors from Oxid Ridge are on the move. Let them come and witness predation in its purest form."
—Glissa

quotes.name: Slip Out the Back
quotes.flavor: "I was never here."

quotes.name: Planar Bridge
quotes.flavor:
"It is finished. Now the real work can begin."
—Tezzeret

quotes.name: Rushwood Dryad
quotes.flavor: To a dryad, every tree in the forest is both a doorway and a window.

quotes.name: Soulstone Sanctuary
quotes.flavor: Explorers mistakenly focused on the hands, not what they could be grasping towards.

quotes.name: Catacomb Crocodile
quotes.flavor:
"I am sewer-king!" said Rat. "I am quick and cunning and I know every tunnel."
"No, I am king!" said Zombie. "I am cold and deadly and no rot can harm me."
Then Croc came and ate them both.

quotes.name: Render Inert
quotes.flavor: As New Phyrexia phased out of existence, glistening oil all across the Multiverse was cut off from its source. The *compleated* invaders ceased to function and crumpled to the ground.

quotes.name: Acrobatic Maneuver
quotes.flavor: Renegades find ever more creative ways to work around the Consulate's aether regulations.

quotes.name: Red Sun's Twilight
quotes.set_name: Phyrexia: All Will Be One Promos
quotes.flavor:
"Where once there was apathy, Urabrask brought passion, and the Great Work truly began."
—Monument inscription

quotes.name: Unstable Molecule Suit
quotes.flavor:
"Clothes that won't burn off? Finally!"
—Human Torch, Johnny Storm

quotes.name: Volrath the Fallen
quotes.flavor: "I stepped out. I did not step down."

quotes.name: Lake-town
quotes.flavor: The Elves spoke of a strange town built right on the surface of the Long Lake, under the shadow of the Dragon-mountain.

quotes.name: Final Flare
quotes.flavor: Those who fought without honor in life are taken to Agonas and doomed to fight forever in its arenas.

quotes.name: Phyrexian Arena
quotes.set_name: Phyrexia: All Will Be One Promos
quotes.flavor: For a bittersweet moment, Jace believed he could still save his love. A moment was all Vraska needed. "For the glory of Phyrexia," she whispered.

quotes.name: Lat-Nam's Legacy
quotes.flavor:
"All the knowledge of Lat-Nam could not protect its sages from the Brothers' War."
—Gerda Äagesdotter, Archmage of the Unseen

quotes.name: Mother of Runes
quotes.flavor: "My family protects all families."

quotes.name: Femeref Archers
quotes.flavor:
"They say a Zhalfirin archer can split the eye of a griffin. Nonsense, of course; they have no faith to guide their darts."
—Nuru, Femeref archer

quotes.name: Ticket Turbotubes
quotes.flavor: "WE ARE FILLED WITH TICKETS. WE ARE FILLED WITH PURPOSE."

quotes.name: Mesmeric Orb
quotes.flavor: The Cult of the Mothman guards these precious eggs, using them to create oils to anoint their effigies.

quotes.name: Hedron Matrix
quotes.flavor: The hedrons awoke along with the Eldrazi, forming superstructures that radiated overwhelming magic.

quotes.name: Access Tunnel
quotes.flavor: Oriq agents stick to the dark corners of Arcavios, unseen yet ever-present.

quotes.name: Sanctum Seeker
quotes.flavor: The Sanctum Seekers were the first of the knightly orders to cross the sea and are still the most zealous.

quotes.name: Spawning Grounds
quotes.flavor: It's the only water source in miles of desert, but the local tribes avoid it at all costs.

quotes.name: Charge
quotes.flavor:
"Honor rides before us. All we have to do is catch up."
—Danitha Capashen

quotes.name: Kjeldoran Escort
quotes.flavor:
"We willingly trade with Kjeldor, but the peace we build must come from both our lands."
—Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian Chieftain

quotes.name: Dwarven Pony
quotes.flavor:
"I hear Halina's got a pony that can count to six—and likes to eat meat."
—Chandler

quotes.name: Marauding Boneslasher
quotes.flavor: With the Hekma destroyed, the wandering dead that sought entrance to Naktamun had free rein to lay waste to the city.

quotes.name: Elven Farsight
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor:
"Few can foresee whither their road will lead them, till they come to its end."
—Legolas

quotes.name: Pithing Needle
quotes.flavor: Occasionally a skaab remembers too much of its former life. Luckily, there's an easy cure.

quotes.name: Archivist
quotes.flavor:
"Words—so innocent and powerless are they, as standing in a dictionary; how potent for good and evil they become to one who knows how to combine them!"
—Nathaniel Hawthorne

quotes.name: Sphinx of the Revelation
quotes.flavor: Crafted from absolute law. Enforcer of absolute order.

quotes.name: Trophy Mage
quotes.flavor: "The tools of the past will help us forge the future."

quotes.name: Gerrard's Irregulars
quotes.flavor: Had Gerrard realized he'd end up fighting against them, he might not have trained them so well.

quotes.name: Eyeless Watcher
quotes.flavor: Every Eldrazi in Ulamog's lineage is an extension of the titan's will.

quotes.name: Corpse Knight
quotes.flavor:
"With each knight that rode out from the bone-white keep, the queen's soldiers felt their courage failing."
—Krinnea, *Siege of the Bone Spire*

quotes.name: Sunspear Shikari
quotes.flavor: Left without their leader Raksha, the leonin split into two prides: one side supported the regent kha, while the other rebelled in fury.

quotes.name: Sneaky Homunculus
quotes.flavor: Keep watch only for the giants and you'll be eaten by the ants.

quotes.name: Patriot, Shield Wielder
quotes.flavor: "They say true heroes always put their teammates before themselves. I often find it's the other way around."

quotes.name: Bloodgift Demon
quotes.flavor: He relishes the devotion of his Skirsdag puppets and their belief that it will earn them immortality.

quotes.name: Frost Lynx
quotes.flavor: If you feel a strange chill within the temperate Quartzwood, look up.

quotes.name: Creeping Mold
quotes.flavor: Mold crept over the walls and into every crevice until the gleaming white stone strained and burst.

quotes.name: Biomathematician
quotes.flavor: "I will reach infinity."

quotes.name: Wind Drake
quotes.flavor:
"But high she shoots through air and light,
Above all low delay,
Where nothing earthly bounds her flight,
Nor shadow dims her way."
—Thomas Moore,
"Oh that I had Wings"

quotes.name: Into the Void
quotes.flavor:
"The cathars have their swords, the inquisitors their axes. I prefer the 'diplomatic' approach."
—Terhold, archmage of Drunau

quotes.name: Impulse
quotes.flavor: "You call it luck. I call it preparation."

quotes.name: Lingering Souls
quotes.flavor: The murdered inhabitants of Hollowhenge impart to the living the terror they felt in death.

quotes.name: Giant Growth
quotes.flavor:
"Here in Fyndhorn, the goddess Freyalise is generous to her children."
—Kolbjörn, Elder Druid of the Juniper Order

quotes.name: Glimmer of Genius
quotes.flavor: Dr. Madison Li's genius was an asset for both Project Purity and, later, the Institute.

quotes.name: Disrupt
quotes.flavor: Teferi wanted no part of Urza's battle plans, but both agreed the Phyrexian portal must be closed.

quotes.name: Frog Tongue
quotes.flavor: "But *why* can't I get one?" sniveled Squee. "All da bugs here got wings."

quotes.name: Sylvan Offering
quotes.flavor: "Learn now the lore of Living Creatures!"

quotes.name: Horizon Canopy
quotes.flavor:
"Not the green and pleasant land we've been led to expect."
—The Seventh Doctor

quotes.name: Viashivan Dragon
quotes.flavor: The Viashivan understand that cruelty arises from opportunity.

quotes.name: Sign in Blood
quotes.flavor:
"You know I accept only one currency here, and yet you have sought me out. Why now do you hesitate?"
—Xathrid demon

quotes.name: Farseek
quotes.flavor: "How truly vast this city must be, that I have traveled so far and seen so much, yet never once found the place where the buildings fail."

quotes.name: Screeching Silcaw
quotes.flavor: It's adaptively deaf to its own cries.

quotes.name: Doorkeeper Thrull
quotes.flavor: Parties at Karlov Manor are strictly invitation only.

quotes.name: Essence Warden
quotes.flavor:
"The more our numbers grow, the more I gain hope that Volrath and his cursed stronghold will one day fall."
—Eladamri, Lord of Leaves

quotes.name: Perilous Research
quotes.flavor: When the School of the Unseen fell, so many magical treasures lay abandoned that no amount of death could deter the stream of thieves and desperate scholars.

quotes.name: Pearl Dragon
quotes.flavor:
"They knew Bantau was lost when, to hide the pearl he had found on the beach, he swallowed it—and soon grew wings."
—Hakim, Loreweaver

quotes.name: Prakhata Club Security
quotes.flavor: It's rare that the Prakhata Club closes its doors. It's also rare that Lord Gonti meets with Consul Kambal. What are the odds the two would occur on the same day?

quotes.name: Ray of Command
quotes.flavor: "Heel."

quotes.name: Fabled Passage
quotes.flavor: From here, the path to anywhere may be found.

quotes.name: Jecht, Reluctant Guardian // Braska's Final Aeon
quotes.flavor: "Well, well, trying to follow in my footsteps, are you?"
